mapper.insert: INSERT INTO allocation_execution(enterprise_id,attempt_id,fulfillment_id,command_id,actor_id,payload_hash,try_payload,cluster_id,transaction_group,launch_owner,next_at,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{row.enterprise_id},#{row.attempt_id},#{row.fulfillment_id},#{row.command_id},#{row.actor_id},#{row.payload_hash},#{row.try_payload},#{row.cluster_id},#{row.transaction_group},#{row.launch_owner},#{row.now},#{row.now},#{row.now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_id=attempt_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM allocation_execution WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a} FOR UPDATE
SELECT state,xid,requested_action,next_warehouse,rpc_attempts,error_code,updated_at FROM allocation_execution WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND attempt_id=#{a}

SELECT FROM allocation_execution WHERE enterprise_id=#{e} AND state IN ('READY','BEGIN_CALLING','TRYING','FINISH_REQUESTED','WAITING_TERMINAL') AND next_at<=#{now} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=#{now}) ORDER BY next_at,attempt_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
